brief.title: Fern — Launch plan
brief.audience: Company leadership approving an app launch
brief.goal: Approve the March 18 launch date and the $420K budget.

direction.concept: Calm, confident launch plan for a personal-finance app: warm paper, deep forest green and one lime signal colour; Helvetica Neue with heavy, tight headlines; each slide makes one claim and shows the evidence for it.

slides.message: Fern launches March 18 with a $420K budget and three owned risks

items.text: Twelve weeks from private beta to public launch, with a $420K budget and three named risks.
App Store review slips past March 1

slides.message: Twelve weeks, three teams, one launch date

items.text: Twelve weeks, three teams, one launch date.
Store submission on February 2 is the gate: it leaves six weeks of review buffer before March 18.
Every team finishes its build work by week 10, so launch week is execution only.

slides.message: Paid social and creators carry 61% of the $420K budget

items.text: Paid social and creators carry 61% of the budget.
$420K across five channels. The $40K contingency is released only with approval in launch week.

chart.alt: Launch budget by channel in thousands of dollars: paid social 160, creators 95, PR and events 70, app store ads 55, contingency 40.

slides.message: Three risks, each with an owner and a trigger

items.text: Three risks. Each one has an owner and a trigger.
Reviewed every Monday. A tripped trigger goes to the launch lead within 24 hours.
Launch date moves and paid media is wasted.
Submit on Feb 2, keeping six weeks of buffer.
New users fail to link accounts in week one.
Raise partner quota; queue links at peak.
Slow replies pull the store rating down.
Train six extra agents; in-app help first.

slides.message: Approve $420K and the March 18 date by January 15

items.text: Approve $420K and the March 18 date by January 15.
A decision this month protects the February 2 store submission and the creator bookings behind it.
WHAT WE COMMIT TO, 30 DAYS AFTER LAUNCH
average star rating in the stores
of new users still active in week 4
**Next review: April 15**, 30 days after launch, against these three goals.
